comparisons.evidence: David superscription entirely supplied in Hebrew transcription; David heading present in Greek
comparisons.classification: heading/reception, not verified Hebrew title ink

comparisons.preservation: outside restoration brackets in published transcription
comparisons.consequence: speaker/grammar alternative; Hebrew participle and Greek finite verb are not identical morphology

comparisons.preservation: dwell verb outside brackets; extra kindness clause partly restored; Selah outside brackets
comparisons.pob: take refuge; no extra kindness clause or Selah
comparisons.greek: hope/trust under wings; no corresponding kindness expansion
comparisons.consequence: lexical variant plus expansion, not just collection order

comparisons.greek: darkness then noon, with explicit demon in noon expression
comparisons.consequence: internal clause transposition; surrounding exorcism not itself a new explicit demon word here

comparisons.preservation: first two letters supplied; refuge broken; following proposed verb only final tav preserved; final suffix disputed in scholarship
comparisons.pob_and_wlc: my refuge / Most High / you have made / your dwelling place; no speech verb
comparisons.greek: Lord/my hope and made-refuge clause, no speech verb
comparisons.consequence: substantially different but damaged sentence; hybrid MT plus Qumran-reconstructed speech verb is not a fully preserved 11Q11 reading
comparisons.strongest_contrary: Speech ellipsis could be legitimate translation; older witness and parallelism can motivate it. Yet alternative reconstructions remain, and present POB construal is grammatically possible.

comparisons.evidence: see-verb beginning survives, last letter supplied; touch/reach verb unbracketed
comparisons.classification: provisional private-transcription lexical comparison, beyond published preview coverage

comparisons.preservation: in-your-ways phrase lies in restoration span; normalized no-all is not a continuous preserved omission
comparisons.greek: printed base lacks all; apparatus records additions
comparisons.consequence: do not delete all on a false claim of fully preserved Hebrew/Greek unanimity

comparisons.preservation: first snake term outside brackets; proposed second snake wholly supplied
comparisons.provenance_limit: Hebrew QDR-only beyond accessible published-preview coverage; provisional until edition/image confirmation
comparisons.pob_and_wlc: lion then venomous snake in first pair
comparisons.greek: two snake terms in first pair
comparisons.consequence: material partial Hebrew–Greek agreement; not two preserved Hebrew snake terms

comparisons.evidence: transcription presents compressed second-person ending and salvation phrase with extensive restorations; closing Amen-Amen supplied
comparisons.provenance_limit: Continuous Hebrew sequence QDR-only beyond accessible published-preview coverage; Guerra independently consulted only for discussion of response/function, not a full Hebrew ending

strongest_general_contrary_explanation: Collection-specific protective or performed adaptation could explain altered address, expansions, sequence and ending; old independent readings may also survive, so genre alone does not settle priority.
